# Your Trusted Chevrolet & Toyota Dealership in Carroll, Iowa

Located just off of W US Hwy 30 in Carroll, Iowa, Motor Inn Auto Group proudly serves drivers throughout Carroll County and surrounding communities with new Toyotas and Chevrolet vehicles, quality used cars, and dependable service, for over 85 years.

If you’re looking for a dependable truck, family SUV, crossover, or reliable sedan, you’ll find it here.
